exploratory_M2PL.evidence: 2PL_EFA_2D numerically agreed with R mirt 1.48 (stage-1 continuation, triangular identification, 2D only)
exploratory_M2PL.limits: 2D only; numerical agreement is not inferential certification; no SE

exploratory_MGRM.evidence: Default tol 1e-7 fails the probability gate again (fresh R fit, phase2_run_45943641718_summary.json). The explicit high-precision profile core.mirt_advanced.fit_grm_high_precision passes every unchanged stage-1 check: max |dP| 6.7e-7, |dLL| 5.4e-11. Runtime: default 8.4 s, plus 4.0 s for the continuation.
exploratory_MGRM.limits: 2D recorded fixture only; explicit profile, no validated automatic trigger; numerical only

exploratory_MGPCM.limits: production permits the fit but has no reference evidence; integration item for Codex-owned UI/status

binary_bifactor.evidence: Bifactor_4D: both engines hit 1000 iterations, all comparisons pass at |dLL|=3e-9; P8 recovery NOT MET (N500 convergence 91/100; N1000 specific RMSE .42 > .30); iteration 1 (run 45938013141): baseline NOT CONVERGED again (iteration cap), so the precision continuation was BLOCKED; Phase II DR diagnostic (quadpts 21, same 1000-iteration budget): R and Python both stop at 1000 iterations; sign-aligned loadings differ by up to 1.30, consistent with a weakly identified, flat ridge. No correctable defect found.
binary_bifactor.limits: historical NOT MET preserved; no new campaign

GRM_bifactor.evidence: Python adapter core.mirt_advanced.fit_polytomous_bifactor (confirmatory orthogonal MGRM, full GH7 grid, 4D). Default settings: probability gate FAIL (4.0e-4 > 1e-4; run 45943641718). Iteration 2, high_precision=True: every unchanged stage-1 check PASS, max |dP| 1.2e-6, |dLL| 9.8e-11 (run 45945188758)
GRM_bifactor.limits: One 4D fixture; high-precision profile required; numerical only; binary bifactor evidence not transferred; production restricted to G + exactly 3 specific factors (2-specific designs did not converge in integration checks)

GPCM_bifactor.evidence: Python adapter vs native R mirt on a common GH7 grid: all unchanged stage-1 checks PASS (max |dP| 9.8e-5, |dLL| 1.3e-6) (phase2_run_45943641718_summary.json)
GPCM_bifactor.limits: One 4D fixture; numerical only; no SE; production restricted to G + exactly 3 specific factors (2-specific designs did not converge in integration checks)

PCM_bifactor.evidence: WITHHELD: slope=1 with unit variances is not the Rasch-testlet PCM, which needs free specific variances; no validated specification

R_backend.executable_in_docker: YES. Run 45946079172: the image builds in about 13 min with TAM 4.3.25 and R mirt 1.48. An actual M4PL fit with --network none gives logLik -2536.18391098392, against -2536.18391098393 archived for direct R
R_backend.blocker: Live hosting is Streamlit Community Cloud, which does not build the Dockerfile; packages.txt (apt) cannot pin R mirt 1.48. The backend therefore refuses explicitly there and Python-only operation is preserved
R_backend.licensing: R mirt is GPL (>= 3); Python mirt 1.2.0 is MIT. Distributing a Docker image that bundles GPL R packages may carry source-availability obligations. Unresolved; not assessed legally

M3PL_fixed_asymptote.evidence: Production SciPy route (core.irt_multidim_general_report) already offers it. The native R backend reproduces the archived direct R fits (|dLL| <= 1e-11), and the two independent engines (R backend vs SciPy) agree on every stage-1 check for 2D within and 3D between cases (phase2_run_45943641718_summary.json)
M3PL_fixed_asymptote.limits: 2D/3D, positive CFA, >=3 pure anchors per dimension, c known; no item SE/CI/p

M3PL_free_asymptote.limits: free-c not enabled because R returns estimates

M4PL_fixed_asymptotes.limits: as M3PL fixed; no asymptote CI
